She lies on her left side with her left cheek sunk into a cream pillow, so her face is horizontal in the frame: forehead toward the right edge, chin toward the left edge, and the line through her two eyes runs vertically. Her upper eye (her right eye) is in the upper half of the frame and its inner corner sits at three fifths of the frame width and one third of the height from the top; her lower eye is half hidden by the pillow and falls softly out of focus. A razor-thin plane of focus lies on the lashes of her upper eye. Her voluminous dark curls fill the right third of the frame, out of focus; the cream pillow fills the lower third; the collar of her khaki short-sleeve shirt over a dark T-shirt shows at the left edge. She is exactly the character of the reference images (the full character sheet, its row of head studies and the clean front view of her head): a round face, warm brown skin, large dark-brown eyes with a small dark wing at the outer end of the upper lash line, thick softly arched dark-brown brows, a small rounded button nose, a small mouth, a few faint freckles and a soft warm blush on the cheeks, a tiny silver diamond-shaped stud earring, and big voluminous dark-brown curly hair with one small curl at the temple. She is a university student about twenty years old drawn with the stylized proportions of her sheet: youthful but not a child, gently defined cheekbones and jaw, natural, no makeup look. She has just woken. Her eyes are open, wet and bright, looking softly past the camera without focusing. The smile is born in her eyes: the lower lids lift, the upper cheek rises, the outer corners crinkle softly, and her mouth is only a small closed smile beginning. One single small tear has just left the inner corner of her upper eye and runs sideways across the bridge of her nose as a thin glistening line with a tiny bead at its tip; never a stream. The feeling is quiet, overwhelming joy, not sadness. Light: low warm morning sun through wooden window shutters. Soft-edged bands of amber light, split by the shutter slats, fall diagonally across her cheek and eyes at about thirty degrees, rising from her jaw toward her upper eyelid; between the bands the skin stays in a gentle petrol-blue shade, about three to one, the darkest tones warm and never black. Two small rectangular catchlights from the shutters shine in each eye, a golden rim of light runs along the curls, and the background is a soft warm blur. Style: refined hand-painted low-poly 3D for a game cinematic, a much denser mesh than the game model. The face is built from many small soft facets that show only as a delicate tessellation in the highlights, each facet painted with a soft gradient and fine brush texture, so the cheeks, eyelids and lips stay round and expressive with no large flat planes and no hard creases across the features. The eyes are smooth painted spheres with a layered iris, a wet waterline and fine individual lashes. The curls are spiral ringlets built from medium facets with hand-painted gradients; the shirt and the pillow keep chunkier facets. Matte, warm and painted. No large flat facets on the face, no plastic or toy-like eyes, no thick outlines, no anime style, no childlike baby face, and the face stays horizontal, never tilted upright. Clean image without film grain. No text, no logos, no insignia, no emblems, no watermark.
